title: Saint Albert the Great, Bishop and Doctor of the Church
short_summary: Saint Albert the Great is honored by the Dominican family as a bishop, Doctor of the Church, and teacher whose learning served the truth of God and the formation of the Church.
key_facts: The Dominican Calendarium lists Saint Albert the Great on November 15.
The Order of Preachers identifies him as a bishop and Doctor of the Church.
The Order's saints and blesseds page says Albert was born at Lauingen in Swabia.
Benedict XVI presented Albert as a teacher whose study ranged across philosophy, theology, and the natural sciences.
In 2026, November 15 falls on a Sunday, so the app keeps the general U.S. calendar day primary.

sections.heading: Learning in the service of preaching
sections.body: Albert's memory belongs naturally to an Order that values study for the service of preaching. His learning was not merely academic; it was directed toward truth and the good of the Church.

sections.heading: Creation and truth
sections.body: Albert's attention to the created world shows that faith does not fear honest inquiry. The world can be studied as God's creation without reducing it to a closed system apart from its Creator.

sections.heading: Teacher and bishop
sections.body: The title Doctor of the Church points to teaching that serves the whole Church. Albert's witness joins intellectual breadth with ecclesial service.

sections.heading: A Sunday occurrence in 2026
sections.body: Because this date falls on a Sunday in 2026, the Dominican overlay is presented as local information while the primary liturgical day remains the general U.S. calendar day.

catholic_connection_sections.heading: Faith seeking understanding
catholic_connection_sections.body: Albert's witness shows that reason, learning, and careful attention to creation can serve faith when they are ordered toward God.

catholic_connection_sections.heading: Study as charity
catholic_connection_sections.body: Dominican study is not self-display. At its best, it becomes charity: patient labor so that the truth can be preached with clarity.

historical_cautions: The OP Saints & Blesseds index displays Saint Albert as a feast, while the Calendarium row used for this overlay gives the proper-calendar rank followed in the app.
